controlPanel.inputEnhancementsDescriptio: Control your phone using your computer's Mouse and Keyboard (OTG mode).
controlPanel.hidKeyboardTooltip: Simulates a physical keyboard. Enables support for special characters and international layouts (e.g., Polish).
controlPanel.hidMouseTooltip: Simulates a physical mouse. Provides high-precision cursor control and eliminates input lag.
controlPanel.pureHidTooltip: Hides the screen mirror. Use your PC purely as a keyboard and mouse for your phone.
controlPanel.hardwareDecodingTooltip: Decode video on the GPU when supported (scrcpy v5+). Disable it if hardware decoding causes artifacts or startup failures.
controlPanel.vsyncTooltip: Sync the frame display to your monitor's refresh rate to eliminate screen tearing (on by default). scrcpy 4.0 (SDL3) disables this by default. Turn off for slightly lower input latency.
controlPanel.webcamProTipTextBefore: Use your phone as a high-quality webcam in Zoom/Teams by capturing this Scrcpy window in
controlPanel.cameraDeviceTooltip: Select a specific lens (e.g. Ultra-Wide, Front) from the list.
controlPanel.refreshLensesTooltip: Click to scan for available camera lenses.
controlPanel.uiScalingTooltip: Lower DPI = Desktop/Tablet feel (larger UI). Higher DPI = Phone feel (smaller, denser UI).
controlPanel.flexDisplayTooltip: Dynamically resize the virtual display to match the scrcpy window size (scrcpy v4+).
controlPanel.cameraTorchTooltip: Enable the device flashlight while streaming the camera feed (scrcpy v4+).
controlPanel.cameraZoomTooltip: Zoom level for camera capture. 1.0 = no zoom. (scrcpy v4+)
controlPanel.backgroundColorTooltip: Hex color for the window background/letterbox area (e.g. #1a1a1a). Leave blank for default dark gray. (scrcpy v4+)
controlPanel.ignoreEncoderConstraintsToo: Skip video encoder size constraints entirely. Use this if scrcpy fails to start or has resolution issues due to the device reporting incorrect encoder limits (scrcpy v4.1+).
sessionBehavior.title: Session Behavior
sessionBehavior.stayAwakeTooltip: Keep the device awake while mirroring is active.
sessionBehavior.screenOffTooltip: Turn off the device screen while mirroring to save battery.
sessionBehavior.forwardAudioTooltip: Requires Android 11 or newer. Android 12+ works out of the box. On Android 11, the device must be unlocked before starting, but audio capture may still be unavailable on some Android TV devices.
sessionBehavior.audioCodecTooltip: Automatically tries compatible audio codecs if the default one fails.
sessionBehavior.alwaysOnTopTooltip: Keep the scrcpy window on top of other windows.
sessionBehavior.fullScreenTooltip: Launch scrcpy in full screen mode.
sessionBehavior.borderlessTooltip: Launch scrcpy without window borders. Position is remembered between sessions. To move the window: Ctrl+Alt+Shift+W on Windows, Super/Meta+drag on GNOME/KDE. If it ever ends up off-screen, press Ctrl+Alt+Shift+C to snap it back to the centre.
sessionBehavior.rememberWindowPositionTo: Reopen the mirror window at the same spot it was last placed. Turn this off if you often change resolution -- it can throw off the saved spot. If it ever ends up off-screen, press Ctrl+Alt+Shift+C to snap it back to the centre.
sessionBehavior.recordFeedTooltip: Record the screen/camera feed to a file.
sessionBehavior.keepActiveTooltip: Simulates user activity to prevent the screen from going idle (scrcpy v4+).
